scenes.heading: Only recommend what you've used or researched

sents.d: Only recommend what you've used or researched
One bad recommendation can undo the trust that many good ones built.
People click your links because they trust your judgment.
One product that flops makes them question every link you share afterward.
Use it yourself for a few weeks, or read the real complaints and the refund policy.
Write down two honest drawbacks and include them in your content.

take: Use it or research it properly, and always share the downsides.
